text: Queue workers on Starter: "Allow scale-to-zero on Starter" — "Starter only, not trials". Starter's one worker may run as start-when-jobs-arrive (0 idle, at most 1). Trials keep one always-on worker. Multi-instance autoscale and extra worker groups stay Pro and above.
